about_the_game:
FREE DEMO! Play chapter 1 by pressing the green button above

In the heights of the Andes, young Bennie tries to enter a mysterious night club in order to find his lost love, Bunny, after a falling out that left Bennie angry and bitter. Now he's convinced he can win his love back by looking for him at the new night club Noctambulo, in the busiest night their small town has seen due to the concert of the famous rock band Lopez Schneider.

Getting there won't be easy though, some shady cats are blocking the way to the club, the people most likely to help him are nowhere to be found and on top of that he doesn't even have an entry ticket!

Jump and Kick instead of Point and Click

The game is built like a platformer, but plays more like a classic adventure game. There's no health bar and no game over. The gameplay is centered around exploring the area, collecting items and solving environmental puzzles in order to progress in the story. You'll have to piece together Bennie's story and pay attention to the details to find the clues necessary to beat the challenges.

Journey to the depths of the party

Navigate the intricate night club making good use of your map. Meet new people and help them out in order to unlock new paths and keep track of their needs in your quest log. Interactions may change according to Bennie's mood so make sure to be in the right state of mind in order to get what you want from someone else.

A promising debut

This is the debut game by artist Ota Jaider and composer Chozz.Art. The game features an original story presented in beautiful pixel art, mixing the aesthetics of traditional andean culture with 60s and 70s urban graphic design. It has an all original soundtrack mixing influences from andean folk, smooth jazz and electro pop.

short_description: A Game Boy Color platformer adventure where you'll have to explore, solve puzzles and collect different items to learn the story of Bennie: A drunk heartbroken rabbit trying to crash a mysterious night club in the Andes.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain
